name: GO oxidation reactor D
processFunction: Batch oxidation of dried Pre-G in sulfuric/phosphoric acid with staged potassium permanganate addition, agitation, external recirculation and temperature control.

design.materialOfConstruction: Glass-lined carbon steel; glass-lined agitator, baffles, dip pipes and thermowell

operatingEnvelope.status: Draft PFD basis; temperature envelope reconciled by data-layer decision D-A200-03 (50 °C = upper allowable limit and SIS trip, 49 °C = TAH; see provenance)
operatingEnvelope.feedRatioBasis: Per kg PRE-G: 66.24 kg H₂SO₄, 6.75 kg H₃PO₄, 4 kg KMnO₄ (feed-rate labels on sheet)

reviewFindings: Area resolved as A-200 from FEED-PFD-0200; the A-140 handoff label is superseded for this asset bank.
PFD lists P-205A/B and M-201 without confirming four dedicated recirculation/induction packages; branch D allocation remains proposed.
Capacity, metallurgy, design pressure and design temperature require an approved equipment datasheet.
Instrument identities, control loops, protective setpoints and relief basis require P&ID and HAZOP/relief-study sources.
